_doc: Request limits per fal endpoint (BRIEF 3.10). generate.mjs requests each sprite at the valid size nearest the sprite's aspect: both sides multiples of `multiple`, at least `min_pixels`, at most `max_pixels`, `max_edge` and `max_aspect`. Among sizes that match the aspect equally well it prefers the one nearest `target_pixels`, and it never exceeds `max_request_pixels` (the size the base price covers) unless no valid size fits under it. `params` lists the input fields the endpoint takes and their allowed values; quality is sent only where the endpoint takes it. Missing fields fall back to `defaults` (fal's own figures where it states them, else 3840 px and 3:1 per BRIEF 3.10). Source: fal model API pages, read 2026-10-21.
